segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: We will work the tag first, then the opening.

segments.speaker: quartet
segments.text: [quartet sings the tag; bass approaches the opening note from below]

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Bass, do not scoop into the first note. Land directly on the center.

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Speak the word once on pitch, then sing the tag again.

segments.speaker: quartet
segments.text: [quartet retries the tag with a centered bass onset]

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Yes, the onset is cleaner.

segments.speaker: lead
segments.text: [lead demonstrates the word time]

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Lead, delay the second half of the diphthong in time.

segments.speaker: tenor
segments.text: [tenor and lead sing the release]

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Tenor, release exactly with the lead.

segments.speaker: quartet
segments.text: [quartet sustains a chord while coach begins speaking]

segments.speaker: unknown
segments.text: [uncertain coach speech over singing] Baritone, maybe soften the third.

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Hum the phrase together first.

segments.speaker: quartet
segments.text: [quartet hums the phrase]

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Now sing it with the words.

segments.speaker: quartet
segments.text: [quartet sings the phrase with words]

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Everyone breathe together before the pickup.

segments.speaker: quartet
segments.text: [quartet sings the pickup and accelerates in the tag]

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Do not speed through the tag.

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Repeat measures twelve through fourteen twice.

segments.speaker: quartet
segments.text: [quartet repeats the passage twice]

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Lead, take responsibility for giving the starting pitch.

segments.speaker: quartet
segments.text: [quartet sings a resonant chord at moderate volume]

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: Keep the volume where it is; increase the ring, not the loudness.

segments.speaker: coach
segments.text: That room is colder than yesterday. Let us take a short break.

segments.speaker: quartet
segments.text: [chairs move; no coaching instruction]
